messages:
Release Bot: quick heads-up: new Dedicated pool 'aurora-fra1' is live in FRA1. Initial capacity: 24 Aurora-X instances. Flavor: Aurora-X (memory-dense, low-power). Tags: #dedicated #aurora #fra1 :sparkles:
Lena V: what's Aurora-X tuned for?
Marco D: Aurora-X is our new memory-first SKU. Target workloads: long-context RAG, embedding indexes, and multi-doc retrieval. VRAM parity ~128GB logical with host NVCache. Expect 12-25% lower cost for heavy KV workloads vs baseline H100 pools.
Soojin H: reservation model? can teams grab steady capacity?
Release Bot: launch mode: 45% reserved commit / 55% burst. Reserve via Console or CLI. CLI example:
```
redwood reserve --pool aurora-fra1 --count 6 --duration 60d --commit monthly --tags team=ml-platform
```
Lena V: any runtime or API changes for model profiles?
Marco D: no API changes. Two model_profile options: aurora-default and aurora-xkv (for large KV). Quantization supported: 8-bit + experimental 4-bit path. If you use custom schedulers, check the runtime note in docs.
Soojin H: fallback routing?
Marco D: default fallback chain: aurora-fra1-compat -> fra1-standard -> europe-h100. Console has toggle for strict routing to avoid fallbacks.
Infra Oncall: ops note: Aurora burst instances are soft-preemptible during FRA maintenance windows. Reserved commits are non-preemptible. We'll publish the maintenance calendar in #infra-maintenance by EOD.
Release Bot: billing: new SKU 'dedicated.aurora' active now. Metering: per-instance-hour. Early adopter promo: 5% rebate for first 60 days if you migrate at least one prod route and tag reservations with team=.
Lena V: performance contact?
Marco D: ping @Infra Oncall and include p95 latency, error rate, and a minimal repro. Also include route id and model_profile.
Soojin H: any known incompatibilities?
Marco D: none observed in smoke tests. If you see numeric quality diffs after quantization, file an eval with Optimize and reference `aurora-fra1` in the report.
Release Bot: rollout plan: day 0 soft-open (this), day 4 double burst capacity if health = green, day 18 open annual commit UI. Docs: https://intra.redwood.dev/dedicated/aurora-fra1 (internal).
Infra Oncall: health checks running now; expect transient metric spikes while agents warm up, not user-facing. Will post updates here.
Lena V: thanks team, scheduling canaries later today.
Marco D: thanks all 123 escalate if you see >6% error or >20% tail latency regression.
